description: Take an on-demand, point-in-time backup of a storage device. Additive (nothing is overwritten) but backups are billed per GB. Asynchronous: the storage goes to a backuping/maintenance state and back to online — poll upcloud_get_storage. UpCloud: POST /1.3/storage/{uuid}/backup.

title.description: A short description for the backup, 1-255 characters.

name: upcloud_create_storage_backup
title: Back up a storage
